title: Wakuli impact report: one flat yellow, real farm photos
note: A coffee company's impact report. It opens on flat #ffff00 with the title in cyan condensed caps plus a light italic year (WAKULI IMPACT 2024), then a small photo of a drying rack grows into a full-bleed farm photo, and the chapters sit on it as yellow pills. Chapters start with an italic (01). The voice is casual (Only legends scroll down). Readymag Websites of the Year 2025, community choice. Worth taking: the colour is loud but the photos are plain documentary shots of the real place.
